pcs.pc_description: use appropriate personal protective equipment and/or work attire prior to carrying out the work in line with relevant occupational health & safety guidelines PPE: appropriate footwear; lab coat; mask; gloves; headgear, apron; etc.
assess potential risks related to work and implement relevant safety measures where applicable
sanitise hands prior to procedure using appropriate sanitiser

ensure personal presentation and grooming is appropriate to convey a professional appearance Personal presentation and grooming: e.g. neatly combed hair, washed and clean hands and face, clean uniform or clothes, trimmed nails, procedure cap and appropriate, odourless socks and footwear, etc
read and interpret correctly the neurotherapy procedure requirement given on the recommendation for the specific customer
estimate time requirements and convey the same to the customer prior to procedure based on procedure specifications and organisational standards
confirm that the materials, tools and equipment required for the procedure are available at hand and ready for use
greet the customer appropriately in a courteous manner
ensure to check that there are no new symptoms or conditions that may require attention prior to procedure
report any new symptoms or conditions to appropriate authority to check its implications for procedures or further customer advise

decline procedures where any new symptoms warrant further requirement or medical attention by informing the customer politely Symptoms: e.g. open wounds, fracture indicated by increasing swelling, unusual tenderness, etc
ensure customer is dressed comfortably and any watch, jewellery or mobile phones are stored away safely prior to commencement of procedure
ensure that the customer is comfortable in the environment for procedure
address any customer feedback, request or complaint regarding the environment to the customer satisfaction or appropriate level of resolution as per organisation standards
ensure the set-up is as per procedure requirement and organisational standard, adjust the set-up as required for customer comfort and procedure requirements

address and respond to customer queries with an appropriate response, provide accurate and relevant information where available, take personal responsibility to come back to the guest with relevant response where required information is not immediately available
politely and clearly instruct the customer to take appropriate position for the specific procedure to be given

assist the customer with requisite physical support to achieve desired position, where required, in a professional manner Professional manner: e.g. take permission from the customer, do not touch the customer inappropriately, ensure customer comfort and dignity, check if the customer is comfortable during and after the shift, etc
change the position of the supporting stands as required
use materials like talcum powder in the required quantity and for approved purpose as per organisational or specified reference standards
ensure the procedure do not cause discomfort or discomfort to the customer

apply appropriate massage techniques and pressure as per specifications in the recommendation and standard practice in line with organisational and referenced standards Massage techniques: e.g. feather touch or light massage, deep tissue massage Specifications: e.g. target bodily points (area) for massaging, duration, direction, number of repetitions, extent of pressure, etc.
adhere to the specified sequence in which procedure is to be done as per the recommendation
complete the procedure sequence within acceptable time frames as per organisational standards

address issues that work against maintaining of a stress and anxiety free environment by ensuring timely and relevant information shared with customer, positive reinforcements, calm and pleasant work environment, etc.
check with the customer if they are satisfied with the procedure in a courteous manner
check if the guest is experiencing any unusual discomfort post the procedure
report any unusual symptoms or conditions to the senior therapist immediately
thank customers for their patronage and wish them appropriately
rearrange the beds, pillows and stands as per standard procedures post the procedure
leave the work area in a safe condition after completing work
return all tools, materials and equipment in appropriate storage location
collect used materials such as foot covers, towels, work clothes, etc. and deposit in the appropriate location for laundry service
exercise safe working practices while dealing with tools and accessories
follow relevant electrical safety practices whenever required
report any work related problems or issues to appropriate personnel in line with relevant regulatory and safety requirements
update records as required post procedure in line with organizational standards

ensure that the client continues with any ongoing allopathic procedure
